findings.message: reviewed PFC component and net graph matches the construction contract
2 copper layers; copper + dielectric + mask = 1.600000 mm, declared 1.600000 mm
component/MPN/pad-net, straight trace and via census match saved board bytes
native evidence contains the supplied board bytes
native copper clears 0.2 mm fabrication floor
nominal control/bleeder model constructed: bus 389.6 V, bleed 0.253 W each, external HOT permit required

coverage_gaps: External isolated bias supply, HOT permit, precharge and bypass sequencing are required; this harness does not implement them.
15 A RMS foldback/PF behavior is a declared input constraint, not a measured result.
Bus bleeder decay, relay timing, semiconductor/capacitor thermal limits, EMC, insulation and mains qualification are NOT RUN.
